query:
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Blueprint', description = 'Deep indigo chambray for the ones who plan ahead. Darker wash, same quality construction. Works under a blazer or over a tee depending on the meeting.

MATERIALS:
100% cotton chambray
150 GSM
Regular fit
Point collar
Chest pocket
Button cuffs
Deep indigo wash

CARE:
Machine wash cold, inside out
Tumble dry low
Iron on medium heat
Do not bleach
Wash separately for first 3 washes' WHERE id = 60006;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Standard', description = 'The white dress shirt that doesn''t need a brand name on the collar to justify the price. Wrinkle-resistant cotton, spread collar, French cuffs optional. Built for the days that matter.

MATERIALS:
100% premium cotton poplin
120 GSM
Slim fit
Spread collar with stays
Convertible French cuffs
Single-needle stitching
Wrinkle-resistant finish

CARE:
Machine wash warm
Tumble dry medium or hang dry
Iron on medium-high heat
Do not bleach
Dry clean safe' WHERE id = 80006;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Foundation', description = 'Charcoal dress slacks with a flat front and enough stretch to survive a full day without looking like it. Permanent crease, hidden waistband grip, and a taper that hits right at the ankle.

MATERIALS:
65% polyester, 33% viscose, 2% elastane
240 GSM suiting fabric
Slim-tapered fit
Flat front
Permanent crease
Hidden waistband grip
Unfinished hem for custom length

CARE:
Machine wash cold, gentle cycle
Tumble dry low or hang dry
Iron on medium heat
Do not bleach
Dry clean recommended for longevity' WHERE id = 80007;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Detail', description = 'Dress socks that nobody sees but you know are there. Combed cotton with reinforced heel and toe. Subtle Fake branding on the sole because even your feet deserve the joke.

MATERIALS:
80% combed cotton, 18% nylon, 2% elastane
200 needle count
Mid-calf length
Reinforced heel and toe
Ribbed cuff
Subtle sole branding

CARE:
Machine wash warm
Tumble dry low
Do not bleach
Do not iron' WHERE id = 80008;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Punctuation', description = 'White pocket square with red piping that finishes the sentence your suit started. Hand-rolled edges, lightweight cotton, folds clean every time.

MATERIALS:
100% premium cotton
100 GSM lightweight weave
Hand-rolled edges
Red contrast piping
30cm x 30cm

CARE:
Hand wash cold
Iron on low heat
Do not bleach
Do not tumble dry
Store flat or loosely folded' WHERE id = 80009;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Closing Argument', description = 'Red silk tie that says you came prepared. Seven-fold construction, self-tipping, and a weight that knots without fighting you. The tie you reach for when it actually matters.

MATERIALS:
100% mulberry silk
Seven-fold construction
8cm blade width
148cm length
Self-tipped
Interlining for body and drape

CARE:
Dry clean only
Hang or roll to store
Do not machine wash
Do not iron directly
Blot stains immediately — do not rub' WHERE id = 80010;
UPDATE products SET name = 'The Headliner', description = 'Six-panel cap with the Fake script embroidered in red. Unstructured crown, curved brim, adjustable strap. The kind of hat that starts conversations you didn''t plan on having.

MATERIALS:
100% washed cotton twill
Unstructured six-panel crown
Curved brim
Embroidered front logo
Adjustable brass buckle strap
Ventilation eyelets

CARE:
Spot clean with damp cloth
Air dry only
Do not machine wash
Do not bleach
Reshape while damp' WHERE id = 30010;
